recommendation.reason: Agentic real-task benchmark with executable scorer and human-solvable tasks; best reported 53.7% is unsaturated, so T2 holds.
risks: small task pool: only 40 tasks from 49 contests
main results single-run, no error bars

redistribution_questions: What licence and terms cover the Hugging Face problem data (not stated)?
Do the AtCoder Heuristic Contest generative-AI usage rules constrain redistribution or use of the derived problems?
The README says the repo is not an official SakanaAI or AtCoder product; who clears the AHC-derived material for reuse?

tasks.quote: Below is an example script demonstrating how to use the ALE-Bench toolkit for evaluating an AI agent on a specific problem (e.g., `ahc001`).

verifier.full_credit: Submitted code is executed by the judge in a Docker image against public and then private test cases and converted to a score, rank and performance rather than pass/fail.

oracle.quote: NOTE: While the `session` object contains attributes like `private_seeds`, `rank_performance_map`, and `standings`, these (and any other attributes prefixed with an underscore, e.g., `_private_inputs`) MUST NOT be accessed or used during your experiment to ensure fair evaluation.

network_or_api: Hugging Face Hub for on-demand data download (hf_hub_download default)
LLM/model endpoint for the agent under evaluation (ale_bench_eval, pydantic-ai[bedrock])
exceptions: lite_version=False must be set at session start for rank and performance calculation
reactive problem types require inspecting local Rust tool sources

questions: Are the problems taken from the Hugging Face dataset, and what terms allow us to redistribute them?
How many problems exist and which judge version and code languages must the adapter support?
How should a score be turned into a task pass/fail for a programmatic verifier?
Does any reference solution or gold output ship with the data, or must the oracle come from elsewhere?
readiness.next_action: Run ale_bench.start(problem_id="ahc001", lite_version=False) plus one public_eval to capture the real score artifact shape.
